That is the code's own year-5 base margin reached within two years and below the FY2018 peak of 49.34%: margins fading more than twice as fast as the code's path, so the price-band contracts did not change the cycle.

kill.description: TTM operating income below $85bn at two consecutive quarter-ends. Quarterly operating income would then be averaging under about $21bn against $43.75bn in the August 2026 quarter: a cyclical fall the contracts did not stop, so FY2026 was the peak.

test.period: each quarter-end to the August 2028 quarter (FY2028)

kill.description: TTM operating cash flow less capex below $26.49bn, the code's own year-1 free cash flow to the firm, at two consecutive quarter-ends. The code's reinvestment charge would then be right, and the extra value the Analyst's case comments describe would not exist.

claims.metric: TTM operating cash flow less TTM capex

kill_criteria.criterion: TTM operating margin below 46.28% at two consecutive quarter-ends before the August 2028 quarter's results: the margin would be fading faster than the code's own path and the price-band contracts would not have changed the cycle.
TTM operating income below $85bn at two consecutive quarter-ends: FY2026's earnings would have been the peak and the cyclical fall not stopped by the contracts.
TTM operating cash flow less capex below $26.49bn, the code's year-1 free cash flow to the firm, at two consecutive quarter-ends: the code's reinvestment charge would be right.
